question_vi: Middleware proxy pattern trong Next.js như thế nào?
question_en: How does the Middleware proxy pattern work in Next.js?
answer_vi: Middleware có thể rewrite requests đến API khác: `NextResponse.rewrite(new URL('/api/proxy', request.url))`. Hoặc trong next.config.js dùng `rewrites` array để proxy: `{ source: '/api/:path*', destination: 'https://backend.com/:path*' }`. Hữu ích để: hide API endpoints, implement BFF (Backend For Frontend), avoid CORS issues.
answer_en: Middleware can rewrite requests to a different API: `NextResponse.rewrite(new URL('/api/proxy', request.url))`. Alternatively, use the `rewrites` array in next.config.js: `{ source: '/api/:path*', destination: 'https://backend.com/:path*' }`. Useful for: hiding internal API endpoints, implementing a Backend For Frontend (BFF), and avoiding CORS issues.
